items.title: Marvin Harrison Jr. Trade Rumors Heat Up Before Deadline
items.one_line: Five catches through four games; Giants reportedly inquired, Eagles/Colts/Patriots/Chiefs/Bears linked; ARI holds his rights through 2027 and isn't eager to move him.

items.title: Cardinals Sign LT Jedrick Wills Jr. After Paris Johnson Jr. Season-Ender
items.one_line: Johnson Jr. out for the year (biceps); rookie Jayden Williams starts at LT for now, Wills (57 starts) signed off BUF practice squad.

items.title: Falcons Crush Saints 45-24 with Record-Tying Five Rushing TDs
items.one_line: MNF: Bijan 145 yds/2 TD, Brian Robinson Jr. 3 short TDs, outrushed NO 205-50; Penix 223 yds in 2nd start back. ATL 2-2.

items.title: Lamar Jackson's Ankle Sprain Clouds Ravens-Falcons SNF
items.one_line: Lamar given only an outside chance for Sunday in Atlanta, Huntley in line to start; story has ATL favored by about 3 at home.

items.title: Lamar Jackson Misses Wednesday Practice Before Falcons SNF
items.one_line: Ankle sprain, outside chance to play, Huntley in line; Flowers, Bateman, Hamilton, Humphrey and Vorhees also did not practice.

items.title: Ravens Acquire Pro Bowl C Cam Jurgens from Eagles
items.one_line: BAL gets Jurgens + 2027 7th for a 2027 5th and 2028 2nd to fill a center void amid injuries; DeCosta calls him a foundational piece.

items.title: Josh Allen's Late INT Fuels Blame Debate After 29-26 Loss
items.one_line: Allen 23/33, 253 yds; picked by Craig Woodson from own 40 at 1:14, admitted he should have thrown it away; Brady took some blame. BUF 3-1.

items.title: Bills DT Deone Walker Dominates in Year Two
items.one_line: 2025 4th-rounder leads interior DL in hurries (15), 19 pressures, 91.6 PFF pass-rush grade through four games.

items.title: Bills-Rams MNF Tests Allen Amid Media Scrutiny
items.one_line: BUF (3-1) at LAR (2-2) Monday; story has Rams 2.5-3 point favorites.

items.title: Bryce Young Leads NFL in Passing Yards Through Four Games
items.one_line: 1,268 yds, 9 TD, 2 INT, 100.0 rating; CAR 2-2 atop NFC South heading into Week 5 bye.

items.title: Tetairoa McMillan Named NFC Offensive Player of the Week
items.one_line: 14 catches, 192 yds, 2 TD vs Detroit in Week 4.

items.title: Ben Johnson Unloads on Packers Before Lambeau
items.one_line: Johnson: 'I hate those guys'; Bagent starts again with Caleb Williams (hamstring) out; CHI 3-1 and slight road favorite.

items.title: Bears Sit Swift, Monangai and Three Starting OL Wednesday
items.one_line: DNP: Swift (hip/knee), Monangai (thumb/toe), Thuney (pec), Jonah Jackson (ankle), Darnell Wright (ankle); Caleb still out. Some may be rest after 89-play game.

items.title: Bears Backups Outshine Caleb Williams in Key Stats
items.one_line: SomerSports graphic: Keenum/Bagent faster time to throw and 59.2% success rate vs Williams' 48.7% under Johnson (small 71-dropback sample).

items.title: Bengals Face Receiver Crisis Before Miami
items.one_line: Chase (concussion protocol) did not practice; Higgins (adductor) in street clothes, Taylor expects him limited.

items.title: Bengals' Under-Center Shift Backfires, Heat on Zac Taylor
items.one_line: Last in yards per play (3.3) after 22-17 loss to JAX; 23 rush yds on 15 carries; Stephen A. calls for a new coach.

items.title: Al Golden Defends Jordan Battle's Missed Tackle
items.one_line: DC says the third-and-18 miss needed gang tackling; fans push back and some call for Golden's job.

items.title: Browns Open 21-Day Windows for Dillon Gabriel and Kalia Davis
items.one_line: QB room now Watson, Sanders, rookie Green plus Gabriel; also signed Proche II and Chris Williams to practice squad, released three.

items.title: Rookie Denzel Boston Leads All Rookies in Receiving
items.one_line: 284 yds on 13 catches (21.8 avg), 2 TD, 92% snaps and 51% of air yards for 3-1 CLE.

items.title: Browns Shopping Jerry Jeudy Before Deadline
items.one_line: Five catches for 62 yds in 2026; Patriots among teams inquiring, $1.2M remaining cap hit this year.

items.title: Cowboys Host Winless Bucs on TNF
items.one_line: Mayfield and Winfield ruled out, rookie Jalon Daniels makes 2nd start; story has DAL opening -8 to -8.5, total ~47.5.

items.title: Cowboys Lead NFL in Scoring Efficiency With Fewest Possessions
items.one_line: 30.5 ppg (2nd) on fewest possessions; Dak 1,065 yds, 8 TD, 1 INT; defense 28th, 112 allowed.

items.title: Lamb's 17 Catches Power 34-30 Comeback at Houston
items.one_line: Career-high 17-189 and the game winner; Dak 335 yds; Dak told Stroud 'shake it off' after.

items.title: Payton: Surtain and Bryant Likely Avoid IR
items.one_line: Both ankles; will miss this week at LAC. CB Riley Moss (ribs) also sat; Barron and Abrams-Draine next up.

items.title: Bo Nix Explains Fewer Runs; Payton Play-Calling Talk
items.one_line: Nix cites better vision and quicker outlets; rumors Payton may take play-calling back from OC Davis Webb.

items.title: Lions Open Practice Windows for Brian Branch and Cade Mays
items.one_line: Branch (Achilles) and Mays (wrist) 21-day windows opened Wednesday; DET on bye.

items.title: ESPN's Fowler: Lions Should Chase Ramsey or Fulton
items.one_line: DET (2-2) leads NFL in passing yards allowed per game; Fowler floats CB trades before the Nov. 10 deadline.

items.title: Savion Williams Returns to Practice, Could Play vs Bears
items.one_line: Rookie WR designated to return from IR; LaFleur didn't rule him out Sunday with Jayden Reed out for the season.

items.title: Packers Sign LB Jack Dingle to Practice Squad After Cooper Injury
items.one_line: Edgerrin Cooper out for season (Achilles); GB worked out five LBs before adding Dingle.

items.title: Bears-Packers Week 5 at Lambeau
items.one_line: GB 2-2 hosts 3-1 CHI; position breakdown favors GB at QB/WR/TE, CHI at RB/OL/LB; CHI slight favorite.

items.title: DeMeco Ryans Takes Over Defensive Play-Calling
items.one_line: After 0-4 start, Ryans takes calls from DC Matt Burke; D allowing 27.3 ppg; TEN next.

items.title: Tank Dell Returns to Practice After 21-Month Knee Recovery
items.one_line: 21-day IR window opened; Ryans says he looked great in limited reps, no firm return date.

items.title: C.J. Stroud Mic'd Up Through 0-4 Start
items.one_line: 1,141 yds, 5 TD, 0 INT through four; led 92-yd hook-and-ladder TD drive vs DAL.

items.title: Colts Sign Carl Lawson to Practice Squad Amid Edge Injuries
items.one_line: Arden Key (hamstring, London) and Micheal Clemons (toe) hurt; Lawson reunites with DC Lou Anarumo.

items.title: Sauce Gardner Calls His Run Support 'Embarrassing'
items.one_line: Self-critique after 30-13 London win over WSH; vows changes in practice. IND 2-2.

items.title: Owner Carlie Irsay-Gordon Defends Sideline Presence
items.one_line: Headset-and-notes role drew attention in London; players and sources say it doesn't interfere.

items.title: Jaguars Face 26 Road Games in Next 30 for Stadium Renovation
items.one_line: $1.4B EverBank rebuild; London vs PHI and HOU this month, 12 different stadiums in 2026. JAX 3-1 atop AFC South.

items.title: Chiefs Contact Tyreek Hill's Agent
items.one_line: Rice and Tyquan Thornton out; Mahomes and Kelce back a reunion; Hill (knee) eyeing a November return.

items.title: Chiefs-Raiders 30-27 Draws Record 28.4M Viewers
items.one_line: Most-watched game of the season so far; KC 4-0.

items.title: Dont'e Thornton Jr. Returns to Practice
items.one_line: WR fully practiced, 21-day window open; Powers-Johnson (groin) limited; LV (3-1) at NE Sunday.

items.title: Ashton Jeanty Under Scrutiny for Negative Runs
items.one_line: League-high 10 negative runs, 3.4 ypc; defenders cite battered OL and lingering ankle; Kubiak owns the run game.

items.title: Raiders Fall 30-27 to Chiefs in Record Audience Game
items.one_line: Cousins' late INT ended it; 28.448M on CBS.

items.title: Chargers Without Alt and Slater, May Start Four Rookie OL vs DEN
items.one_line: Alt (neck), Slater (ankle), McConkey and Derwin James out; Harbaugh praises rookies. LAC 0-4.

items.title: Chargers Add Daniel Brunskill to Practice Squad
items.one_line: Veteran OL depth (knows McDaniel's system); windows opened for Matlock and Branson Taylor.

items.title: Rams Host Bills on MNF
items.one_line: LAR (2-2) slight 2.5-3 point favorites vs BUF (3-1) at SoFi.

items.title: Rookie WR Caleb Douglas Still Out; Kenneth Grant Returns to Practice
items.one_line: Douglas (ankle) doubtful vs CIN; first-round DT Grant back from IR; MIA 0-4, bye after CIN.

items.title: Vikings Sign Odell Beckham Jr. to Practice Squad
items.one_line: Depth with Jefferson (ankle) and Addison (hamstring) hurt; reunites with O'Connell. MIN 4-0, at NO Sunday.

items.title: Donovan Jackson to IR With Torn Meniscus
items.one_line: 2025 first-rounder out for the season; Joe Huber at LG; practice squad shuffled, Hekker released.

items.title: James Pierre Allowing 2.1 Passer Rating
items.one_line: PFF: three catches allowed, one INT, 77.9 grade on limited snaps.

items.title: Patriots Win 29-26 at Buffalo
items.one_line: Maye 3 TD incl. game-winner to Efton Chism with 1:50 left; AFC Offensive Player of the Week; NE 2-2.

items.title: Patriots Work Out Jamaal Williams Amid Stevenson Injury Scare
items.one_line: Stevenson nursing possible high-ankle/MCL issue; NE also worked out four others and shuffled practice squad.

items.title: Patriots Among Teams Inquiring on Jerry Jeudy
items.one_line: Browns shopping Jeudy before Nov. 10 deadline.

items.title: Olave Gets Rest Day; Kamara Sits With Back Issue
items.one_line: Olave's DNP called planned rest, expected back Thursday; Kamara (back) out Wednesday before MIN.

items.title: Shough Under Fire Over Middle-Field Passing
items.one_line: 30/48, 286 yds vs ATL under 24 pressures; ranks 13th in PFF grade, 1,203 yds, 9 TD.

items.title: Malik Nabers Sits Out Practice With Knee Soreness
items.one_line: Surgically repaired knee; status vs WSH uncertain; Andrew Thomas (groin) and Pinnock (concussion) also hurt.

items.title: Braxton Berrios Out for Season After Foot Surgery
items.one_line: Giants added Jake Haener to active roster, Dontae Fleming to practice squad; four healthy WRs.

items.title: ESPN's Schatz: Giants Among Weakest 3-1 Teams Since 2000
items.one_line: DVOA-based take on the NFC East leaders; WSH, NO, HOU next.

items.title: Glenn's Injury Update Before Browns
items.one_line: Hall, A. Mitchell and Parham week-to-week; Brownlee in concussion protocol; Mason Taylor and Enagbare cleared; Tim Patrick IR window open.

items.title: Garrett Wilson Addresses Three-Game Skid
items.one_line: After 23-12 loss at CHI, NYJ 1-3; 24-270-2 on the season, trade chatter despite deal through 2030.

items.title: Eagles Trade Pro Bowl C Cam Jurgens to Ravens
items.one_line: Jurgens + 2027 7th for a 2027 5th and 2028 2nd, a day after Lane Johnson retired.

items.title: Barkley and DeVonta Smith Miss Practice Before London
items.one_line: Both hamstrings; Greenard (ankle) and Epps (groin) also out; Goedert and Baun returned.

items.title: Tank Bigsby to IR; Dameon Pierce Elevated
items.one_line: Bigsby core-muscle surgery; Brockermeyer to practice squad, Orji released, Ezukanma added.

items.title: Michael Pittman Jr. Scoots Through Locker Room on Bad Foot
items.one_line: Limited Wednesday, foot issue all season (7-89 in three games) before facing old team IND.

items.title: Rodgers-McCarthy Hot Mic Exchange After Browns Loss
items.one_line: Both downplayed it; PIT 2-2 after 27-24 TNF loss.

items.title: Seahawks Pass on Joe Mixon After Physical
items.one_line: Signed Dontae McMillan to practice squad, elevated Robert Henry Jr.

items.title: 49ers' Zero Sacks Allowed Meets Seahawks' Top Pass Rush
items.one_line: SEA leads ESPN pass-rush win rate (69%); SF slight road underdog at Lumen Sunday.

items.title: Brock Purdy Leads Early MVP Race
items.one_line: 126.2 rating, 89.7 QBR, 0.55 EPA/play, 0 sacks on 113 attempts; +400 MVP odds; at SEA Sunday.

items.title: 49ers Add Xavier Smith to Practice Squad
items.one_line: Dante Pettis (calf) to practice-squad IR; ex-Rams returner adds WR/ST depth.

items.title: Bucs at Cowboys TNF: Mayfield, Winfield Out
items.one_line: Jalon Daniels 2nd start; Morrison and SirVocea Dennis also out; story lists DAL -8 to -9.5, total ~47.5.

items.title: Jayden Daniels Practices Fully, Expected to Start vs Giants
items.one_line: Elbow brace; 23 on the injury report incl. Diggs and McLaurin (hamstrings) and Mariota (knee).

items.title: Commanders Open Windows for Trey Amos, Deatrich Wise, Jeremy McNichols
items.one_line: All three back at practice; 21-day evaluation windows.

items.title: Commanders Sign WR Nick DeGennaro to Practice Squad
items.one_line: Depth with Jaylin Lane out for season and McLaurin hurt; DT Jeffrey M'Ba released.
